from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,sys,pandas as pd,numpy as np
ROOT=Path.cwd();OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_fed_reserve_three_cause_weekly_score_v1'
assert not (OUT/'result.json').exists() and not (OUT/'run_started.json').exists(),'固定实验已有执行记录，不重复拟合。'
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def clean(v):
 if isinstance(v,dict):return {str(k):clean(x) for k,x in v.items()}
 if isinstance(v,(list,tuple,np.ndarray)):return [clean(x) for x in v]
 if v is pd.NaT or v is pd.NA:return None
 if isinstance(v,(pd.Timestamp,datetime)):return v.isoformat()
 if isinstance(v,np.integer):return int(v)
 if isinstance(v,np.bool_):return bool(v)
 if isinstance(v,(float,np.floating)):return float(v) if np.isfinite(v) else None
 return v
def save(name,v):(OUT/name).write_text(json.dumps(clean(v),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8',newline='\n')
def csv(name,f):f.to_csv(OUT/name,index=False,encoding='utf-8-sig')
protocol=json.loads((OUT/'protocol.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
registration=json.loads((OUT/'model_registration.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
sg=json.loads((OUT/'source_gate.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert sg['all_actual_calendar_dates_present'] and sg['release_count']==208
for rel,h in registration['input_hashes'].items():assert sha(ROOT/rel)==h,rel
save('run_started.json',{'started_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
 'protocol_sha256':sha(OUT/'protocol.json'),'model_registration_sha256':sha(OUT/'model_registration.json'),
 'source_series_sha256':sg['series_sha256'],'single_fixed_run':True,'parameter_searches':0})
sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT/'research'))
import multidim_money_surprise_score_v1 as model
assert model.TREE==protocol['tree']
daily=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/registration['daily_input']).sort_values('idx').reset_index(drop=True)
daily['date']=pd.to_datetime(daily.date).dt.tz_localize(None)
assert daily.idx.eq(np.arange(len(daily))).all() and daily.date.is_unique and daily.date.is_monotonic_increasing
decision_times=pd.DatetimeIndex(daily.decision_time)
assert decision_times.is_monotonic_increasing
sources=pd.read_parquet(ROOT/registration['source_series']).sort_values('available_at').reset_index(drop=True)
causes=protocol['cause_definitions'];base=protocol['features_control'][:8]
coverage_rows=[]
for _,q in sources.iterrows():
 item=q.to_dict();i=int(decision_times.searchsorted(q.available_at,side='right'))
 item.update(state_idx=None,decision_at=pd.NaT,entry_date=pd.NaT,exit_date=pd.NaT,entry_at=pd.NaT,exit_at=pd.NaT,actual_net5=np.nan,status='NO_FOLLOWING_PRICE_CLOSE')
 if i<len(daily):
  state=daily.iloc[i];at=state.decision_time
  item.update(state_idx=i,state_date=state.date,state_available_at=at,decision_at=at,
   funding_available_at=state.funding_available_at,orders_available_at=state.orders_available_at)
  for f in base:item[f]=float(state[f])
  item['公布月份正弦']=float(np.sin(2*np.pi*q.release_date.month/12))
  item['公布月份余弦']=float(np.cos(2*np.pi*q.release_date.month/12))
  item['era']='2024—2025' if at.year>=2024 else '2022—2023'
  if at.year not in (2022,2023,2024,2025):item['status']='DECISION_OUTSIDE_FIXED_YEARS'
  elif not state.valid_features or not np.isfinite(state[base].to_numpy(float)).all():item['status']='MISSING_STATE_FEATURES'
  elif i+6>=len(daily) or not np.isfinite(state.net_label):item['status']='MISSING_COMPLETE_PRICE_WINDOW'
  else:
   entry=daily.date.iloc[i+1];exitdate=daily.date.iloc[i+6]
   item.update(status='READY',entry_date=entry,exit_date=exitdate,exit_idx=i+6,
    entry_at=entry.tz_localize('Asia/Shanghai')+pd.Timedelta(hours=9,minutes=30),
    exit_at=exitdate.tz_localize('Asia/Shanghai')+pd.Timedelta(hours=9,minutes=30),actual_net5=float(state.net_label))
   assert q.available_at<at<item['entry_at']<item['exit_at']
   assert item['funding_available_at']<=at and item['orders_available_at']<=at
 item['status_before_duplicate_rule']=item['status'];coverage_rows.append(item)
coverage=pd.DataFrame(coverage_rows)
duplicate=coverage.state_idx.notna() & coverage.duplicated('state_idx',keep='last')
coverage.loc[duplicate,'status']='DUPLICATE_CHINA_STATE_LATEST_RELEASE_USED'
coverage.to_parquet(OUT/'全部208公布及中国决定日覆盖.parquet',index=False);csv('全部208公布及中国决定日覆盖.csv',coverage)
events=coverage[coverage.status.eq('READY')].sort_values('decision_at').reset_index(drop=True)
events.state_idx=events.state_idx.astype(int)
assert events.state_idx.is_unique and events.event_id.is_unique
assert np.isfinite(events[protocol['features_joint']].to_numpy(float)).all()
events.to_parquet(OUT/'周度公布共同状态及原五日标签.parquet',index=False)
div=pd.read_csv(ROOT/'data/reference/510300_dividends.csv');div['record_date']=pd.to_datetime(div.record_date)
max_label_error=0.
for r in events.itertuples():
 a=daily.iloc[r.state_idx+1];b=daily.iloc[r.state_idx+6]
 buy=np.ceil(float(a.open)*1.001*1000-1e-9)/1000
 sell=np.floor(float(b.open)*.999*1000+1e-9)/1000
 ent=float(div.loc[div.record_date.ge(a.date)&div.record_date.lt(b.date),'cash_dividend_per_share'].sum())
 paid=10000*buy+max(5.,10000*buy*.0004)
 received=10000*(sell+ent)-max(5.,10000*sell*.0004)
 max_label_error=max(max_label_error,abs(received/paid-1-r.actual_net5))
assert max_label_error<1e-12
def path(tree,current):
 node=0;steps=[]
 while tree['children_left'][node]!=tree['children_right'][node]:
  name=tree['features'][tree['feature'][node]];value=float(np.float32(current[name]))
  threshold=float(tree['threshold'][node]);left=value<=threshold
  steps.append({'node':node,'field':name,'value':float(current[name]),'float32_comparison_value':value,'threshold':threshold,'direction':'left' if left else 'right'})
  node=tree['children_left'][node] if left else tree['children_right'][node]
 return node,steps
def linear(pool,current,features):
 x=pool[features].to_numpy(float);y=pool.actual_net5.to_numpy(float)
 mean=x.mean(axis=0);scale=x.std(axis=0,ddof=1);scale[scale<1e-12]=1
 z=np.clip((x-mean)/scale,-5,5);zmean=z.mean(axis=0);centered=z-zmean
 coef=np.linalg.solve(centered.T@centered+10*np.eye(len(features)),centered.T@(y-y.mean()))
 prediction=float(y.mean()+(np.clip((current[features].to_numpy(float)-mean)/scale,-5,5)-zmean)@coef)
 return prediction,{'features':features,'mean':mean,'scale':scale,'zmean':zmean,'coef':coef,'ymean':float(y.mean())}
rows=[];models=[];excluded=[];leaf_records=[];path_records=[];max_leaf_error=0.;max_score_error=0.
for _,current in events.iterrows():
 pool=events[events.state_idx.ge(current.state_idx-504)&events.exit_at.le(current.decision_at)]
 if len(pool)<12:
  excluded.append({'event_id':current.event_id,'decision_at':current.decision_at,'mature_events':len(pool),'reason':'固定12次成熟事件未满足'});continue
 assert pool.event_id.ne(current.event_id).all() and pool.exit_at.le(current.decision_at).all()
 assert (pool.available_at<pool.decision_at).all()
 cp,cs,ct=model.fit_tree(pool,current,protocol['features_control'])
 jp,js,jt=model.fit_tree(pool,current,protocol['features_joint'])
 lp,lm=linear(pool,current,protocol['features_joint'])
 current_paths={}
 for kind,prediction,score,tree in [('control',cp,cs,ct),('joint',jp,js,jt)]:
  leaf,steps=path(tree,current);members=[];fitted=[]
  for _,training in pool.iterrows():
   training_leaf,_=path(tree,training);fitted.append(float(tree['value'][training_leaf]))
   if training_leaf==leaf:
    members.append(training)
    leaf_records.append({'model':kind,'prediction_event_id':current.event_id,'decision_at':current.decision_at,'leaf':leaf,
     'training_event_id':training.event_id,'training_entry_date':training.entry_date,'training_exit_date':training.exit_date,
     'training_exit_at':training.exit_at,'training_actual_net5':training.actual_net5,
     **{f:training[f] for f in causes}})
  replay=float(pd.DataFrame(members).actual_net5.mean())
  rank=float(100*((np.array(fitted)<prediction).mean()+.5*(np.array(fitted)==prediction).mean()))
  max_leaf_error=max(max_leaf_error,abs(replay-prediction));max_score_error=max(max_score_error,abs(rank-score))
  fields=[x['field'] for x in steps];current_paths[kind]=fields
  path_records.append({'model':kind,'event_id':current.event_id,'decision_at':current.decision_at,
   'prediction':prediction,'score':score,'leaf':leaf,'path':steps,'member_event_ids':[s.event_id for s in members],
   'causes_actually_used':[f for f in causes if f in fields]})
 record=current.to_dict()
 record.update(control_prediction=cp,control_score=cs,joint_prediction=jp,joint_score=js,
  linear_prediction=lp,mean_prediction=float(pool.actual_net5.mean()),training_events=len(pool),
  training_event_ids=';'.join(pool.event_id),training_max_exit_at=pool.exit_at.max(),
  cause_any_tree_node=any(f in jt['used_features'] for f in causes),
  cause_on_actual_path=any(f in current_paths['joint'] for f in causes),
  control_path_fields='；'.join(current_paths['control']),joint_path_fields='；'.join(current_paths['joint']))
 for num,f in enumerate(causes,1):record['cause_'+str(num)+'_on_actual_path']=f in current_paths['joint']
 rows.append(record)
 models.append({'event_id':current.event_id,'decision_at':current.decision_at,'training_event_ids':pool.event_id.tolist(),
  'control_tree':ct,'joint_tree':jt,'linear':lm})
pred=pd.DataFrame(rows);assert len(pred)>0 and len(pred)<=len(events)
csv('逐周公布三原因联合评分.csv',pred);save('saved_models.json',models);save('未评分的成熟事件.json',excluded)
csv('全部训练叶成员.csv',pd.DataFrame(leaf_records));save('全部实际路径.json',path_records)
buckets=[];errors=[];opportunities=[]
for kind in ['control','joint']:
 next_at=pd.Timestamp('1900-01-01',tz='Asia/Shanghai')
 for _,row in pred.iterrows():
  if row.decision_at<next_at or row[kind+'_score']<80 or row[kind+'_prediction']<=0:continue
  opportunities.append({'model':kind,'event_id':row.event_id,'era':row.era,'signal_date':row.decision_at,
   'entry_date':row.entry_date,'exit_date':row.exit_date,'score':row[kind+'_score'],'prediction':row[kind+'_prediction'],
   'net_return':row.actual_net5,'cause_on_actual_path':bool(row.cause_on_actual_path) if kind=='joint' else False,
   'actual_path_fields':row[kind+'_path_fields'],**{f:row[f] for f in causes}})
  next_at=row.exit_at
 for era,block in pred.groupby('era',sort=False):
  bands=np.minimum((block[kind+'_score']/20).astype(int),4)
  for band in range(5):
   selected=block.loc[bands.eq(band)]
   buckets.append({'model':kind,'era':era,'score_band':f'{band*20}—{(band+1)*20}',**model.return_summary(selected.actual_net5)})
for era,block in pred.groupby('era',sort=False):
 for kind in ['control','joint','linear','mean']:
  errors.append({'era':era,'model':kind,'mse':float(((block[kind+'_prediction']-block.actual_net5)**2).mean()),'n':len(block)})
opp=pd.DataFrame(opportunities,columns=['model','event_id','era','signal_date','entry_date','exit_date','score','prediction',
 'net_return','cause_on_actual_path','actual_path_fields',*causes])
summary=[];annual=[]
for kind in ['control','joint']:
 for era in ['2022—2023','2024—2025']:
  selected=opp[opp.model.eq(kind)&opp.era.eq(era)]
  summary.append({'model':kind,'era':era,**model.return_summary(selected.net_return)})
 for year in range(2022,2026):
  selected=opp[opp.model.eq(kind)&pd.to_datetime(opp.entry_date).dt.year.eq(year)]
  annual.append({'model':kind,'year':year,**model.return_summary(selected.net_return)})
csv('同事件全部五档比较.csv',pd.DataFrame(buckets));csv('四项模型误差.csv',pd.DataFrame(errors))
csv('全部固定高分机会.csv',opp);csv('高分机会比较.csv',pd.DataFrame(summary));csv('高分机会逐年次数.csv',pd.DataFrame(annual))
primary=pred[pred.era.eq('2024—2025')];earlier=pred[pred.era.eq('2022—2023')];assert len(primary)>0
jhigh=opp[opp.model.eq('joint')&opp.era.eq('2024—2025')];chigh=opp[opp.model.eq('control')&opp.era.eq('2024—2025')]
def windowset(f):return set((pd.Timestamp(x.entry_date).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),pd.Timestamp(x.exit_date).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')) for x in f.itertuples())
control_windows=windowset(chigh)
newhigh=jhigh[[(pd.Timestamp(x.entry_date).strftime('%Y-%m-%d'),pd.Timestamp(x.exit_date).strftime('%Y-%m-%d')) not in control_windows for x in jhigh.itertuples()]] if len(jhigh) else jhigh.copy()
csv('主期不同于匹配对照的机会.csv',newhigh)
jmse=float(((primary.joint_prediction-primary.actual_net5)**2).mean());cmse=float(((primary.control_prediction-primary.actual_net5)**2).mean())
jmean=float(jhigh.net_return.mean()) if len(jhigh) else None;cmean=float(chigh.net_return.mean()) if len(chigh) else None
gates={'primary_joint_mse_not_worse_than_matched_control':jmse<=cmse,
 'primary_joint_high_mean_net5_positive':jmean is not None and jmean>0,
 'primary_joint_high_mean_not_worse_than_matched_control_when_nonempty':jmean is not None and (cmean is None or jmean>=cmean),
 'at_least_one_primary_joint_high_date_not_in_control':len(newhigh)>0,
 'at_least_one_primary_new_high_path_actually_uses_new_cause':len(newhigh)>0 and bool(newhigh.cause_on_actual_path.any())}
assert set(gates)==set(protocol['increment_gate']);gate=all(gates.values())
assert max_leaf_error<1e-12 and max_score_error<1e-10
unchanged={rel:sha(ROOT/rel)==h for rel,h in registration['input_hashes'].items()};assert all(unchanged.values())
verification={'all_208_release_rows_preserved':len(coverage)==208,'calendar_count':208,'no_duplicate_china_price_labels_in_training':events.state_idx.is_unique,
 'all_source_dates_known_before_decision':bool((events.available_at<events.decision_at).all()),'all_training_labels_mature':True,
 'common_pool_for_models':True,'max_saved_original_net_label_error':max_label_error,'max_leaf_mean_error':max_leaf_error,
 'max_percentile_score_error':max_score_error,'input_hashes_unchanged':unchanged,'repository_py_sources_modified':False,
 'source_first_vintage_verified':False,'independent_validation':False,'causal_equity_effect_identified':False}
save('必要复核.json',verification)
result={'study_id':protocol['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E9','completed_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),
 'status':'COMPLETED_FIXED_WEEKLY_RESERVE_SCORE_ACCOUNT_ADMISSION_PASSED' if gate else 'REJECTED_FROZEN_FED_RESERVE_CAUSE_INCREMENT_NOT_ESTABLISHED',
 'classification':'PROGRESS_WEEKLY_UPSTREAM_THREE_CAUSE_INCREMENT_TEST','official_calendar_releases':208,'source_objects':210,
 'source_first_vintage_verified':False,'availability_proxy':'实际美国正文日末上界，首个中国交易日16点状态，下一开盘入场',
 'eligible_unique_price_events':len(events),'coverage_status_counts':coverage.status.value_counts().to_dict(),
 'unscored_insufficient_mature_events':len(excluded),'scored_events':len(pred),'primary_scored_events':len(primary),'earlier_scored_events':len(earlier),
 'daily_input_end':daily.date.max(),'common_calendar_controls':2,'control_features':10,'joint_features':13,
 'tree':protocol['tree'],'total_new_fits':3*len(pred),'fits_per_family':len(pred),'parameter_searches':0,
 'primary_same_predictions_as_control':int(np.isclose(primary.joint_prediction,primary.control_prediction,atol=1e-12,rtol=0).sum()),
 'all_actual_cause_path_events':int(pred.cause_on_actual_path.sum()),'primary_actual_cause_path_events':int(primary.cause_on_actual_path.sum()),
 'primary_cause_path_counts':{f:int(primary['cause_'+str(n)+'_on_actual_path'].sum()) for n,f in enumerate(causes,1)},
 'primary_joint_mse':jmse,'primary_control_mse':cmse,'primary_joint_high_count':len(jhigh),'primary_control_high_count':len(chigh),
 'primary_joint_high_mean_net5':jmean,'primary_control_high_mean_net5':cmean,
 'primary_new_high_count':len(newhigh),'primary_new_high_cause_path_count':int(newhigh.cause_on_actual_path.sum()),
 'primary_new_high_event_ids':newhigh.event_id.tolist(),'gate_components':gates,'full_account_admission_passed':gate,
 'model_errors':errors,'buckets':buckets,'opportunity_summary':summary,'annual_opportunities':annual,
 'new_accounts':0,'account_net_sharpe':None,'goal_achieved':False,'independent_validation':False,
 'orders_authorized':False,'new_prospective_forecasts_enabled':False,'current_view':'NO_VIEW','position':'UNSET','new_repository_code_edits':0}
save('result.json',result)
print(json.dumps(clean({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['buckets','annual_opportunities']}),ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print('主期全部固定高分：');print(opp[opp.era.eq('2024—2025')].to_string(index=False))
